acceptance_reason: Fixture scope is implemented and verified through the Python venue/account path. Venue-certified historical rules and native liquidation remain unavailable, so full TASK-10 closure evidence cannot be claimed.
scope: Point-in-time venue rules, funding settlement, isolated margin tiers, mark-based liquidation and reconciliation implemented in Python only, bound to the independent exact Account oracle.

limitations.claim: No historical venue rule files are available in this repository. The loader accepts bitemporal rules but the rules used by tests and evidence are test fixtures with source=TEST_FIXTURE, not venue-published schedules.
limitations.evidence: venue_profiles/ and native/venue/ do not exist; all rules carry source=TEST_FIXTURE.
limitations.impact: Cannot claim venue-certified historical fee, funding, tier or mark schedules.

limitations.claim: Margin tiers, maintenance rates and liquidation fee rates are fixture-declared values, not certified exchange tier tables.
limitations.impact: Liquidation thresholds are reproducible for fixtures but not certified for historical venue replay.

limitations.claim: The pinned native engine has no liquidation or maintenance-margin path. Native code only processes funding position adjustments; it does not force-close positions.
limitations.evidence: grep -rin 'liquidat|maintenance|adl' native/ returns no matches; native/runner/src/main.rs handles Funding adjustments only.
limitations.impact: Liquidation is Python-oracle only. No native liquidation parity is claimed.

limitations.claim: ADL and auto-deleveraging are not implemented or modelled.
limitations.evidence: UNSUPPORTED_VENUE_BEHAVIOR contains ADL; SCOPED_SUPPORT['adl'] and ['auto_deleveraging'] are false.
limitations.impact: Venue behavior outside isolated maintenance-margin liquidation is explicitly out of scope.

limitations.claim: Only isolated, full-position liquidation at the declared mark is supported. Cross-margin liquidation and partial liquidation are not implemented.
limitations.impact: Mixed-margin accounts and partial forced closes are not certified.

limitations.claim: A mark is never inferred from a quote/book or from a future-only rule. Missing marks fail closed with MISSING_SETTLEMENT_MARK or FUTURE_ONLY_MARK.
limitations.impact: Correct fail-closed behavior, but venues whose marks are only observable later cannot be settled by this profile.

limitations.claim: The F11/F12 maintenance profile is supplied by fixture setup (maintenance_rate) and mapped to an explicit MARGIN_TIER rule or profile default.
limitations.evidence: tests/test_venue.py ruleset() constructs the tier explicitly; no venue tier document is loaded.
limitations.impact: No hidden defaults: maintenance is only enabled when the profile or rule explicitly declares it.

non_claims: No native liquidation execution or parity.
No ADL, auto-deleveraging, cross-margin or partial liquidation.
No mark inference from quotes or future-only rules.
No claim that fixture-derived maintenance/tier values are exchange-published.

negative_cases_verified.MISSING_SETTLEMENT_MARK: F10 and unit negative case; no funding posted and no mark inferred.
negative_cases_verified.UNKNOWN_RULE: Missing rule or unsupported rule kind fails closed.
negative_cases_verified.LOOKAHEAD_RULE: Rule known after decision time is rejected.
negative_cases_verified.CONFLICTING_RULE: Same valid+known window with different value is rejected.
negative_cases_verified.DUPLICATE_SETTLEMENT: Exact duplicate settlement is rejected; equal amounts in distinct settlements survive.
negative_cases_verified.TIER_NOT_FOUND: Notional outside all tiers fails closed.
negative_cases_verified.LEVERAGE_EXCEEDED: Notional above tier leverage fails closed.
negative_cases_verified.RECONCILIATION_FAILURE: Fee sign, funding sign and reservation mutations each break exact reconciliation.
